summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on refining the process for updating `device_session_calibration_3` records. Initially, it was decided to target only active companies that have sent data in the last month, excluding inactive or 'dead' companies.

Multiple SQL queries were reviewed and refined to ensure accuracy when adding default calibration entries. The final approach involved selecting company IDs from a predefined list of active companies and excluding any records where the company already has an existing calibration entry (especially those lacking `facility_id` or `category`).

A key refinement addressed how partner relationships affect data inclusion, ensuring that if a partner has an existing calibration record, it is skipped. The final step involved changing the default value to 89 and correcting a specific UK company record.
decisions: The scope for updating device session calibration records will be limited to active companies that have sent data in the last month.
A refined SQL query was finalized to insert new default calibration entries into `device_session_calibration_3`.
action_items: Execute the final, optimized SQL script to update device session calibration records.
Correct the specific UK company record that was incorrectly added previously.
